name: Chat history, full — scrolled
summary: The same twelve, scrolled. The content sits 36px up, the title passes under the nav's fade, and a 4px scroll indicator appears at the right edge.

looseEnds.title: The scroll indicator is drawn, not derived
looseEnds.detail: The thumb sits at y=463 in a 620px track — at the very end — while the content has moved only 36px of a possible 32. The same thumb, at the same offset and the same 157px height, is drawn on the 50-chat frame over a completely different scroll position.
looseEnds.ask: Treat the indicator as native scroll chrome rather than a drawn element, or state the track and thumb maths.

looseEnds.title: The title scrolls under the nav with no treatment of its own
looseEnds.detail: At this offset 'Chat history' and '12 chats' are partly behind the nav's white fade. Nothing is drawn for a condensed or pinned title, so the heading simply disappears as the list moves.
looseEnds.ask: Is a collapsing header in scope, or does the heading scroll away?
